node.title: L1 first-match totality scope pin
node.statement: For any finite set of distinct image-fiber contributors, each with a nonempty finite set of carrying chart keys, assigning each contributor to its least carrying key gives a disjoint exhaustive first-owner partition. Thus image contributors are counted exactly once and valid owner-cell bounds may be summed without duplication. This is the multivalued-chart form of upstream's kernel-checked prefixFibreAtlas_total theorem. The later general first-layout theorem separately removes maximal source-layout multiplicity; this node supplies no payment for internal contributor-dependent rechart cells.
